title: gf2-core SparseFieldMatrix sparse-matmul + sparse-rref over GF(p) and GF(2^m)
description:
Extend `gf2-core`'s `SparseFieldMatrix<F>` with sparse × sparse matmul (over GF(p) and GF(2^m)) and sparse RREF (over GF(2^m)). Filed per user decision on 2026-05-04 in response to a3412e15's exclusion proposals #3, #4 (sparse×dense × GF(2^m), sparse-elim × GF(2^m)) and #2 (sparse-matmul × GF(p), GF(2^m)): rather than excluding these cells, implement gf2-core's own paths so they become self-reference cells.

## Background

Per a3412e15's design doc:
- `sparse-matmul × GF(p)` and `sparse-matmul × GF(2^m)` lack public sparse×sparse matmul in candidate libraries; gf2-core's own implementation is the canonical reference.
- `sparse-elim × GF(2^m)` cannot be benched today because gf2-core does not expose `SparseFieldMatrix<Gf2mWide<…>>::rref`.

This task closes those four cells by adding the missing gf2-core paths.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `SparseFieldMatrix<F>::matmul(&self, other: &Self) -> Self` exists for `F: FiniteField`, producing canonical CSR output.
- [hard] `SparseFieldMatrix<Gf2mWide<W>>::rref(&self) -> Self` exists for sparse Gauss-Jordan over GF(2^m).
- [hard] Output of both is bitwise-equal to the dense-roundtrip equivalent for tested input ranges.
- [hard] Benchmarks in `crates/gf2-core/benches/sparse_*.rs` cover `(n, density) ∈ {(1024, 1/n), (4096, log(n)/n)}` for `F ∈ {Fp<7>, Fp<65521>, Gf2mWide<u8>, Gf2mWide<u32>}`.
- [hard] Tail-masking invariant preserved (per CLAUDE.md key invariant 1).
- [hard] No unsafe in this module — sparse work stays in `gf2-core` proper.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `doc-review` pass.

## References

- `dev/plans/sparse_benchmark_corpus.md` § 6 proposals #2, #3, #4 (the exclusions this task replaces).
- `crates/gf2-core/src/sparse/` for the existing CSR structure.
- `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs` for the GF(2^m) backing type.
